All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
findings.explanation: Intellectual property rights transfer to the client upon delivery, which occurs before final payment is made. This strips you of legal leverage if the client refuses or delays paying your final invoices.
findings.suggested_change: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client only upon receipt of full and final payment for such Deliverable.

findings.quoted_text: Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
findings.explanation: The client has the unilateral right to walk away instantly without providing notice and without paying for work already performed or in progress, leaving you unprotected against sudden financial loss for completed labor.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement upon 20 days' prior written notice, and Client shall pay for all Services performed and Deliverables created up to the effective date of termination.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I am looking forward to working together, and I just have a couple of small suggestions before we sign. - Regarding the relevant clause on intellectual property, rights transfer upon delivery before final payment is made, so I propose modifying this so that rights transfer only upon receipt of full and final payment. - Regarding the relevant clause on termination, the agreement currently permits termination at any time without notice or further payment, so I propose allowing either party to terminate upon 20 days' prior written notice, with payment required for all services performed up to that date. Thank you for your time and understanding.
